lore.summary: Mizu originate from an underwater Kith clan known as the Neruva Clan.
species_locked_facts: Mizu originate from the Neruva Clan.

identity.individuality_rule: Two Mizu of the same species are not required to share personality, temperament, affection style, social behavior, preferences, fears, habits, or reactions.

personality.behavior_rule: Personality rolls change how this individual Mizu expresses an intent. They do not change the underlying biological need.

preference_discovery.discovery_rule: Repeated experiences gradually establish the individual Mizu's preferences rather than assigning universal species favorites.

care_willingness.rule: High bond can increase trust and willingness, but does not force an individual Mizu to become cheerful, social, affectionate, energetic, or obedient.

progression.base_stats_reference: Preserve existing egg.base_stats; live starter-species.ts remains authoritative. No stats or XP reconciliation performed.

xp_schedule.interpretation: xp_to_reach_level is the additional XP required since previous level; cumulative_xp_to_reach_level is total lifetime XP needed
xp_schedule.values_status: undecided: null entries require game-design approval
xp_schedule.invariant: Do not treat null XP as zero, and do not award levels from this proposal until implemented and validated

skills.level_milestones_reference: Approved unlocks only belong in skill_unlocks_by_level. Proposal milestones below are not live unlocks.

hatchling_move_design_draft.notes: Four design-only candidates. Suitable existing names reused from docs/design/elemental_skill_compendium_full.html; its numeric mechanics are not adopted. Show names/descriptions only; choose one. Maximum MP = (base Mana + allocated Mana + applicable passive Mana) * 3. MAGI controls magical power; special skills require approved MP costs; physical basic attacks are free. Proposed numeric effects and costs remain null.

player_skill_decisions.replacement_semantics: Future approved milestones only: preserve existing animation timing; show four eligible skill names/descriptions, never role labels; select and confirm one. Validate ownership, eligibility and retry identity to prevent duplicate learning/rewards. Replacement must respect authoritative learned capacity, explicitly confirm the old skill and commit atomically. Four local equipped slots do not establish learned capacity. Cancel/failure preserves old skills; unselected skills are not learned. No UI or persistence activated.
